tree.heading: Considerations.—
tree.text: In deciding whether to award a charter to a bidder, the Secretary of Transportation shall consider—

children.text: the bidder’s financial resources, credit standing, and practical experience in operating vessels; and
other factors a prudent business person would consider in entering into a transaction involving a large capital investment.

tree.heading: Disqualifications.—
tree.text: The Secretary may not charter a vessel to a person appearing to lack sufficient capital, credit, and experience to operate the vessel successfully over the period covered by the charter.
